items.name: Fintype.card_Icc
items.type: {α : Type u_1} [Preorder α] [LocallyFiniteOrder α] (a b : α) [Fintype ↑(Set.Icc a b)] : Fintype.card ↑(Set.Icc a b) = (Finset.Icc a b).card

items.name: Finset.card_Icc_prod
items.type: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [Preorder α] [Preorder β] [LocallyFiniteOrder α] [LocallyFiniteOrder β] [DecidableLE (α × β)] (x y : α × β) : (Finset.Icc x y).card = (Finset.Icc x.1 y.1).card * (Finset.Icc x.2 y.2).card

items.name: Finset.card_Ico_eq_card_Icc_sub_one
items.type: {α : Type u_2} [PartialOrder α] [LocallyFiniteOrder α] (a b : α) : (Finset.Ico a b).card = (Finset.Icc a b).card - 1

items.name: Finset.card_Ioc_eq_card_Icc_sub_one
items.type: {α : Type u_2} [PartialOrder α] [LocallyFiniteOrder α] (a b : α) : (Finset.Ioc a b).card = (Finset.Icc a b).card - 1

items.name: Finset.card_Ioo_eq_card_Icc_sub_two
items.type: {α : Type u_2} [PartialOrder α] [LocallyFiniteOrder α] (a b : α) : (Finset.Ioo a b).card = (Finset.Icc a b).card - 2
